businessSnapshot: Mid-tier Indian IT services firm focused on AI-led digital engineering and enterprise modernisation; BFSI and hi-tech lead growth.
~27,500 people across 21 countries; Salesforce and AWS are key partners.
Announced the acquisition of Nagarro (Europe-centric digital engineering; ~€1 bn equity value) in Aug 2026, bridge-financed by Barclays.

narrativeVsNumbers: Top line agrees with the story: revenue +30% YoY in rupees (+20% in USD) in Q2 FY27 — among the fastest in Indian IT.
Profit does not: EBITDA margin slid from 19% to 14% in four quarters and PAT fell 25% YoY (₹471 → ₹352 cr), partly deal costs, partly tool amortisation and wage hikes.
The balance sheet is about to change character — from net cash to a €1.4 bn bridge-financed deal plus $1.25 bn of debt and equity.
The funding narrative reversed inside one quarter (no QIP → $450M equity), so treat integration guidance with care.
bull: Best-in-class growth (20% USD YoY) with AI-led engineering demand and large-deal ramp-ups.
Nagarro roughly doubles scale and deepens Europe; management expects cash-EPS accretion from year 1 and margin uplift from Persistent's delivery practices.
Cash conversion is strong (OCF/PAT ~97% TTM) and ROCE ex-cash ~46% gives room to service deal debt.
bear: Integrating a large, lower-margin European business while organic margins are already falling.
Equity dilution ($450M) plus significant leverage; currency and Euribor exposure on the bridge.
Guidance credibility took a hit on the QIP reversal; the $2 bn FY27 aspiration now needs a steep H2.
